title: gypsophila reuteri
intro: Gypsophila reuteri, commonly known as Baby's Breath, is a flowering plant species native to Europe. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Gypsophila reuteri are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its health benefits.
